text:
maria.k: Quick ask: field needs a 1-pager battlecard vs cloud AI platforms, LLM APIs, and infra vendors. Required: 3 core claims, 3 evidence bullets, 2 rebut lines, 1 demo hook. Can anyone own?
raj.p: Ill draft claims + rebut lines. Need bench + SLA wording.
oliver_d: Ill write demo hook and a short customer quote.
jen_product: Note: call out quality caveat for quantized models and mention Optimize rollback.
sam_marketing: SDRs want a single-slide snapshot (latency vs cost) and 3 scannable soundbites.
lia_ops: benchbot finished run -> benchbot? summary please.
benchbot: Uploaded: p95 latency hosted 120ms, dedicated 70ms; fallback models +30% latency. Dedicated unit cost ~0.6x hosted steady-state. CSV + charts in /shared/bench/173310.
maria.k: Use bench numbers as one evidence bullet. Priorities: reliability, predictable economics, unified runtime, private options.
raj.p: Draft claims:
- Production-first reliability: p95 SLAs + automatic failover to keep apps online.
- Predictable economics: reserved/dedicated capacity and batching reduce token spend vs pay-per-call APIs.
- Unified developer experience: one API + consistent observability across hosted/dedicated/private.
oliver_d: Rebut example: "If they say cloud endpoints are simpler -> those endpoints can force region locks and patch timing; we offer private control plane and rollback policies."
jen_product: Quality caveat line: "Quantized variants can shift outputs; Redwood Optimize links regressions to prompts and automates rollbacks."
sam_marketing: SDR one-liner: "Redwood: predictable inference  lower unit cost, built-in fallbacks, and enterprise privacy."
maria.k: Assignments: Raj = assemble 1-pager, Lia = SLA phrasing (contract check), Oliver = customer quote, Sam = SDR copy + objection handlers. Timeline: doc ready for review EOD, design handoff tomorrow, SDR slide Monday.
raj.p: Link to draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1xEXAMPLE  please comment.
lia_ops: SLA draft: "99.9% uptime with multi-region fallback; per-route latency targets and automatic fallback to compatible variants."
oliver_d: Customer quote (anonymized): "Switched to Redwood, cut inference spend 35% while keeping SLAs during peak."
sam_marketing: I'll add two quick objection handlers: price and vendor lock-in.
maria.k: Thanks team  ship small and fast. :rocket:
